verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's docs directly document tracking spend per key, user, team, and by tags across 100+ providers via the proxy's cost tracking feature, plus budgets, virtual keys, and admin UI to view spend — matching the story closely. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the cost dashboard's accuracy/UX and explicit per-model spend breakdown evidence beyond the general 'across 100+ LLMs' claim.
